short: zaf's design knowledge, a Basic Memory project
is: zaf's store of design knowledge as plain Markdown notes kept with the repo: where zaf is going, what the Engineer ruled, and what is still open.
conventions: Each note opens with Basic Memory front matter (title, type, tags, permalink `zaf/...`) and links others as [[Title]]
Notes hold durable knowledge only, never working papers or run status
What is decided or learned is written here in the same change: update the note it belongs to, or add one and link it from zaf-overview.md
A note goes in domain/ (what zaf is), decisions/ (what was ruled) or roadmap/ (what is open)

fs.name: README.md
fs.role: the one-time setup on a fresh clone: install basic-memory, register this folder as the project `zaf`

fs.name: decisions/
fs.role: scheduler-rulings.md: the Engineer's scheduler rulings of 2026-11-12

fs.name: domain/
fs.role: principle.md (the design rules), vocabulary.md (the scheduler direction's words, one meaning each) scheduler.md (the scheduler) and the-mcp.md (zaf's MCP server and the facts checked of it)

fs.name: roadmap/
fs.role: open-decisions.md: what the scheduler direction left unruled as of 2026-11-13

fs.name: zaf-overview.md
fs.role: start here: what zaf is, with links to every other note

notes: The repo's .mcp.json starts a Basic Memory server limited to the project `zaf`; the search index lives outside the repo in ~/.basic-memory/ and is rebuilt from these files
zaf/CLAUDE.md says to read zaf-overview.md before design work
What is built is in docs/zaf-actions.md; the Engineer's own document is zaf/zuri.domain.md
